description: A young boy is trying to grow taller by drinking milk and eating vegetables. He wants to get a minimum of 100 units of calcium and 50 units of iron per day. A glass of milk costs $1 and contains 40 units of calcium and 25 units of iron. A plate of vegetables costs $2 and contains 15 units of calcium and 30 units of iron. How many of each should he consume to minimize his cost?

MinCalcium.definition: Minimum required units of calcium per day

MinIron.definition: Minimum required units of iron per day

MilkCost.definition: Cost of a glass of milk

MilkCalcium.definition: Units of calcium in a glass of milk

MilkIron.definition: Units of iron in a glass of milk

VegetableCost.definition: Cost of a plate of vegetables

VegetableCalcium.definition: Units of calcium in a plate of vegetables

VegetableIron.definition: Units of iron in a plate of vegetables

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of consuming milk and vegetables while meeting the minimum calcium and iron requirements"
